relationships.subject: Nav1.7 A1632G
relationships.evidence_quote: we introduced the mutation into control induced pluripotent stem cells, which generated hyperexcitability, providing causality.

relationships.subject: Nav1.7 A1632G
relationships.evidence_quote: Inherited erythromelalgia, small fibre neuropathy and paroxysmal extreme pain disorder are caused by gain-of-function mutations in the voltage-gated sodium channel Nav1.7.

key_findings: Patient iPSC-derived sensory neurons carrying Nav1.7 A1632G show electrophysiological changes not previously seen in cell lines.
CRISPR/Cas9 correction of A1632G reduced hyperexcitability, and introducing it into control iPSCs generated hyperexcitability.
